text:
harper: Morning — Merchantly reported an unexplained +520k embedding tokens on their Apr 10 invoice. No config or traffic spike on their side. tagging finance+eng.
dimitar: Can you paste a sample request_id? I'll query embedding_events.
harper: Support ticket includes IDs: MCH_9001, MCH_9007. Time window ~2029-04-10T01:00-02:00Z.
olivia: Quick grep shows MCH_9001 exists 3x with same idempotency_key but different request_id values. Looks like our ingestion accepted both idempotency and request_id headers but later dedupe step compared only request_id.
dimitar: Ah — we recently changed the ledger dedupe key to prefer request_id for performance. If proxies rewrite request_id per hop, dedupe fails even when idempotency exists.
billing-bot: Alert: dedupe-exception-rate merchant=merchantly over last 3h = 1.1% (>0.5%).
harper: So root cause likely dedupe-key precedence change. What's the rollback/patch path?
olivia: Short term: change billing dedupe to prefer idempotency_key when present. I'll open PR `billing/dedupe-prefer-idempotency`.
dimitar: I'll run a dry aggregation to estimate token delta. Query: ```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT idempotency_key, count(*) cnt, sum(tokens) toks
  FROM embedding_events
  WHERE customer_id = 'merchantly' AND event_time >= '2029-04-10'::date
  GROUP BY idempotency_key
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) SELECT sum((cnt - 1) * (toks / cnt)) as dup_tokens FROM dup;
```
-- dry-run: 522,410 duplicate tokens.
harper: At $0.00013/token that's $67.91. Finance can pre-approve provisional credit if dry-run confirmed.
billing-bot: Backfill job BF-2029-770 created. Dry-run scheduled.
olivia: Patch ready, will canary and then prod. Also adding a regression test to ensure dedupe logic covers idempotency_key precedence.
qa-bot: Regression test `dedupe_precedence_test` added to CI.
dimitar: Dry-run complete, matches earlier number. Uploaded CSV with affected request_ids to ticket BF-2029-770.
harper: Approved the ledger credit. Kevin (finance) please post memo "dedupe-backfill: dedupe-key precedence regression (Apr 10)" and notify Merchantly after posting.
billing-bot: BF-2029-770 dry-run completed. Potential ledger impact: -$67.91. Awaiting manual approval.
harper: Approved. Please also include a short postmortem noting the recent change to dedupe key and add a monitoring rule: alert if per-customer dedupe rate spikes >0.3% in 1h after dedupe logic changes.
olivia: Will do. Patch merged and deployed to prod. Closing loop once ledger entries complete and customer notified.
